items.text: UDavide wakhuluma amazwi aleli hubo kuJehova mhla uJehova emkhulula esandleni sezitha zakhe zonke nasesandleni sikaSawule;
Wathi: “UJehova uyidwala lami, nenqaba yami, nomsindisi wami;
Nkulunkulu wedwala lami; ngithembele kuye: uyisihlangu sami nophondo lwensindiso yami, inqaba yami ephakemeyo nesiphephelo sami, umsindisi wami; Uyangisindisa ebudloveni.
Ngiyakumbiza uJehova ofanele ukudunyiswa; ngakho ngizakhululwa ezitheni zami.
Lapho amaza okufa engihaqa, izikhukhula zababi zangethusa;
Izinhlupheko zesihogo zangizungeza; izingibe zokufa zangivimbezela;
Ekuhluphekeni kwami ngambiza uJehova, ngambiza uNkulunkulu wami, walizwa izwi lami ethempelini lakhe, ukukhala kwami kwangena ezindlebeni zakhe.
Umhlaba wazamazama, wazamazama; izisekelo zezulu zanyakaza, zazamazama, ngokuba wayethukuthele.
Kwenyuka umusi emakhaleni akhe, nomlilo emlonyeni wakhe wadla; amalahle abaswe ngakho.
Wawathoba amazulu, wehla; nobumnyama babuphansi kwezinyawo zakhe.
Wakhwela phezu kwekherubi, wandiza, wabonakala emaphikweni omoya.
Wamisa ubumnyama baba ngamathende akhe nxazonke, amanzi amnyama namafu ezulu.
Amalahle omlilo avutha ngokukhazimula phambi kwakhe.
UJehova waduma ezulwini, oPhezukonke walizwakalisa izwi lakhe.
Wathuma imicibisholo, wabahlakaza; umbani, wabadunga.
Kwabonakala imisele yolwandle, izisekelo zomhlaba zambulwa ngesijeziso sikaJehova ngokuphephetha komoya wamakhala akhe.
Wathumela ephezulu, wangibamba; Wangikhipha emanzini amaningi;
Wangisindisa esitheni sami esinamandla nakubo ababengizonda, ngokuba babenamandla kunami.
Bangivimbezela ngosuku lwesigemegeme sami, kepha uJehova waba yinsika yami.
Wangikhipha wangiyisa endaweni enkulu; Wangisindisa, ngokuba wayethokozile ngami.
UJehova ungivuzile njengokulunga kwami; njengobumsulwa bezandla zami ungibuyisele.
Ngokuba ngizigcinile izindlela zikaJehova, angisukanga kuNkulunkulu wami ngobubi.
Ngokuba zonke izimiso zakhe zaziphambi kwami, nezimiso zakhe angisukanga kuzo.
Futhi ngangiqotho phambi kwakhe, ngazilinda ebubini bami.
Ngakho uJehova ungibuyisele njengokulunga kwami; njengokuhlanzeka kwami phambi kwamehlo akhe.
Konesihawu uyakuba nomusa, kolungileyo uzibonakalisa uqotho.
Kohlanzekileyo uyozibonakalisa uhlanzekile; futhi kokungalungile uzobonisa ukucasuka kwakho.
Abantu abacindezelweyo bayakukhulula, kepha amehlo akho aphezu kwabazidlayo, ukuze ubawise.
Ngoba wena Jehova uyisibani sami, futhi uJehova uyokhanyisa ubumnyama bami.
Ngoba ngawe ngadabula iqembu lezigelekeqe, ngoNkulunkulu wami ngeqa umduli.
UNkulunkulu yena, indlela yakhe iphelele; izwi likaJehova lihloliwe; Uyisihlangu kubo bonke abamethembayo.
Ngoba ngubani onguNkulunkulu ngaphandle kukaJehova? Ngubani oyidwala ngaphandle kukaNkulunkulu wethu na?
UNkulunkulu ungamandla ami namandla, wenza indlela yami iphelele.
Wenza izinyawo zami zibe njengezezindluzele, ungimisa ezindaweni zami eziphakemeyo.
Uzifundisa izandla zami ukulwa; ukuze izingalo zami zephule umnsalo wensimbi.
Wanginika isihlangu sensindiso yakho, nobumnene bakho bungikhulisile.
Uzandisile izinyathelo zami phansi kwami; ukuze izinyawo zami zingasheleli.
Ngazixosha izitha zami, ngazichitha; futhi angiphendukanga ngaze ngabaqeda.
Ngaziqeda, ngazilimaza, ukuze zingavuki; yebo, zawa phansi kwezinyawo zami.
Ngoba ungibhincise amandla okulwa; abangivukele wehlisele phansi kwami.
Futhi unginikile intamo yezitha zami, ukuze ngichithe abangizondayo.
Babheka, kepha kwakungekho msindisi; kuJehova, kepha akabaphendulanga.
Ngabashaya bancane njengothuli lomhlaba, ngabagxoba njengodaka lwasemgwaqweni, ngabasakaza.
Futhi wangisindisa ekuxabaneni kwabantu bami, wangilondoloza njengenhloko yezizwe; abantu engingabazi bayongikhonza.
Abezizwe bayakuzithoba kimi; ngokushesha nje lapho bekuzwa, bayongilalela Mina.
Abafokazi bayakunyamalala, besatshwe ezindaweni zabo eziseduze.
UJehova uyaphila; futhi libusisiwe idwala lami; makaphakanyiswe uNkulunkulu wedwala lensindiso yami.
UNkulunkulu ongiphindiselelayo, owehlisela abantu phansi kwami;
Ongikhipha ezitheni zami; Ungiphakamisile phezu kwabangivukelayo; Wangikhulula kumcindezeli.
Ngalokho ngiyakukubonga, Jehova, phakathi kwezizwe, ngihubele igama lakho.
Ungumbhoshongo wensindiso yenkosi yakhe, uhawukela ogcotshiweyo wakhe, kuDavide nakuyo inzalo yakhe kuze kube phakade.
